snippet.description:
Learn Cartesian curve tracing step-by-step with solved examples for B.Sc. Maths, Calculus, and university engineering exams. Master symmetry, intercepts, and asymptotes easily.

Is video me hum Cartesian curves ki curve tracing step-by-step detail me seekhenge. Pichhle lecture me humne general procedure aur rules cover kiye the, aur is lecture me hum actual algebraic equations aur standard problems ko solve karke 2D coordinate plane par sketch karna seekhenge.

Agar aap B.Sc. Mathematics, B.Ed., ya Engineering Calculus ki taiyari kar rahe hain, toh ye topic aapke exams ke liye behad important hai.

📌 Topics Covered in this Video:

Cartesian curves tracing ka step-by-step process
Symmetry check karna (about X-axis, Y-axis, opposite quadrants)
Origin aur tangents at origin identify karna
Intercepts aur region of existence (real domain) find karna
Asymptotes parallel to axes and oblique asymptotes calculate karna
Solved examination problems and accurate graph plotting


Timestamps
00:00 – Introduction & Recap of Curve Tracing Rules
01:40 – Example 1: Tracing $y^2(a + x) = x^2(a - x)$
02:37 – Symmetry & Origin Analysis
05:14 – Tangents at Origin & Node Point
08:19 – Finding Asymptotes Parallel to Axes
10:48 – Intercepts & Region of Existence
17:23 – Manual Curve Sketching
19:56 – Graph Verification using Desmos Calculator
20:52 – Example 2: Tracing $x^2 y^2 = (1 + y)^2 (4 - y^2)$
22:36 – Symmetry & Origin Check
24:08 – Asymptotes Parallel to Axes
25:51 – Intercepts on Coordinate Axes
27:14 – Valid Region of Existence
29:26 – Manual Curve Sketching
33:30 – Desmos Graph Verification
34:40 – Example 3: Folium of Descartes ($x^3 + y^3 = 3axy$)
35:48 – Symmetry about $y = x$ & Origin Check
37:20 – Tangents at Origin (Node Point)
38:41 – Finding Oblique Asymptote ($x + y + a = 0$)
42:30 – Points of Intersection & Quadrant Region
47:28 – Manual Sketching of the Loop & Branches
50:39 – Desmos Graph Verification & Next Lecture Preview

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

Curve Tracing Rules & Examples  → https://youtu.be/jSEg6cPhR1s

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Happy Learning! 📐✨
